meta.description: Frontend-only map of the Overwatch match-tracker React app: every page and component down to individual UI elements (buttons, inputs, cards, charts, etc.), each carrying a copy-pasteable `grep` command that jumps straight to its exact source line. Intended both for Sean to click through in the browser and for Claude Code to read directly as a lookup table when asked to change a specific piece of UI.
meta.generated: frontend UI-element snapshot, extracted from live source (client/src) via parallel agent read + grep-verified anchors, at analysis time
meta.howToUse: Click a node to see its file and, for page/component nodes, a 'UI Elements' list. Each element's locate.grep is a ready-to-paste `grep -n -F -- "<anchor>" <file>` command — run it in the repo root (~/Code/overwatch) to land on the exact line. Uses plain grep (not ripgrep) deliberately: ripgrep isn't installed on this machine outside the Claude Code sandbox, so grep is what will actually work when pasted into a real terminal. locate.path is the file:line at extraction time as a secondary reference (may drift if the file is edited above that line; the grep command will not).

nodes.label: App.tsx
nodes.description: Root component. Holds the dark/light theme toggle button, wraps everything in Hero/Map/MatchEdit drawer + match context providers, mounts the router inside a fixed embossed "OVERWATCH" header and background crest, and globally mounts DeathLogger/MapDrawer/HeroDrawer/MatchEditDrawer as siblings of the router so they can render on top of any page.

uiElements.label: Theme toggle button
uiElements.description: Fixed top-right circular button (sun/moon glyph) that flips dark/light mode and persists the choice to localStorage.

nodes.label: React Router
nodes.description: BrowserRouter routes. '/', '/prematch', '/log', '/trends' are aliases that all render Dashboard (those sections now live as stacked sections on one page, not tabs). '/sens' and '/sens/analysis' are a separate, intentionally unlinked sensitivity-study area sharing the same backend/DB.

nodes.label: Dashboard.tsx
nodes.description: Single continuous-scroll page (not tabbed) composing every top-level section in order: a Mode card (queue-mode selector tiles), a Recent Matches card (win-rate readout + match history strip + tilt warning banner), the Match section embedding Prematch + LogMatch, a Trends section embedding TrendsSummary, and a Career section of all-time stat tiles.

uiElements.label: Section jump nav
uiElements.description: Sticky wayfinding rail under the header standing in for section tabs on this one-long-scroll page; pill links jump to Mode, Recent Matches, Match, Trends, and Career, highlighting the currently in-view section.

uiElements.label: Mode tiles (queue-mode selector)
uiElements.description: Three clickable tiles (QP, Comp Role, Comp Open) that double as a queue-mode selector; clicking one sets the active queue mode used by the advisor and match log, shows recent/all-time win rate and most-played hero for that mode, and flashes green/red when a new match is logged under it.

uiElements.label: Mode card
uiElements.description: Card wrapping the queue-mode selector; titled 'Mode' and holds the three mode tiles.

uiElements.label: Recent Matches card
uiElements.description: Card titled 'Recent Matches' containing the win-rate summary, the recent-match history strip, and (when applicable) the tilt warning banner.

uiElements.description: Displays the win rate over the last 25 logged games with an animated percentage and a trend arrow/delta comparing it against the last 100 games.

uiElements.label: No matches logged empty state
uiElements.description: Placeholder banner shown in the recent-match strip when no matches have been logged yet, prompting the user to log their first result.

uiElements.label: Tilt warning banner

nodes.label: Prematch.tsx

uiElements.label: No-DPI-test-running banner
uiElements.description: Placeholder message shown inside the DPI Test HUD card when no DPI stage test is currently active, prompting the user to start one on the Sens page.

uiElements.label: Map Voting card

uiElements.label: Map search input

uiElements.label: Vote for (winner map) button
uiElements.description: Shows the recommended map to vote for based on blended win-rate score; clicking it opens the Map drawer for that map.

uiElements.label: Hero Advisor card
uiElements.description: Card for choosing the current map, which drives the hero recommendations, coaching, and hero-selection panel shown lower on the page.

uiElements.label: Hero Advisor clear button
uiElements.description: Clears the currently selected map, reverting the Hero Advisor and Your Heroes panels back to their idle state.

uiElements.label: Map selector
uiElements.description: Dropdown to choose the current match's map, which drives hero recommendations, coaching, and the your-heroes breakdown across the page.

uiElements.label: Map type badge
uiElements.description: Pill badge showing the game-mode type (e.g. Escort, Control, Flashpoint) of the currently selected map.

uiElements.label: Today W/L stat tile
uiElements.description: Shows today's win/loss tally; idle-state filler in the Hero Advisor card shown when no map is selected.

uiElements.label: Streak stat tile
uiElements.description: Shows the current win or loss streak length; idle-state filler in the Hero Advisor card shown when no map is selected.

uiElements.label: This hour stat tile
uiElements.description: Shows the historical win rate for the current hour of day; idle-state filler in the Hero Advisor card shown when no map is selected.

uiElements.label: Consolidated Advisor card
uiElements.description: Main card below the top row combining the recommended hero pick, LLM coaching, and the full your-heroes-by-role breakdown for the selected map.

uiElements.label: 'Your Heroes on {map}' map link
uiElements.description: Clickable map name in the Consolidated Advisor card's header that opens the Map drawer for the currently selected map.

locate.grep: grep -n -F -- 'Your Heroes on <button onClick={() => openMap(map)}' client/src/pages/Prematch.tsx

uiElements.label: Refresh advisor icon-button
uiElements.description: Icon button (↻) that re-fetches the LLM pre-match advisor recommendation for the current map and queue mode.

uiElements.label: Recommended pick panel
uiElements.description: Highlighted panel shown when no map is selected, with one column per role (DPS/Support) showing that role's hottest-trending hero (biggest recent-vs-prior win-rate climb) with recent win rate and games played.

uiElements.label: Recommended hero name button
uiElements.description: Clickable hero name inside the Recommended Pick panel; opens the Hero drawer for that hero.

uiElements.label: Coaching section
uiElements.description: Section shown once a map is picked, embedding the LLM tactical-read AdvisorCard (matchup coaching and death patterns) for that map.

uiElements.label: 'Select Your Hero' section header
uiElements.description: Header labeling the hero-selection panel that lists top heroes per role for the currently selected map.

uiElements.label: Hero picker list (by role)
uiElements.description: Two-column (DPS/Support) list of every hero with an active sens test, ranked by win rate on the selected map — shown even with 0 games logged on that map, no top-N cap or collapsed overflow; clicking a hero pre-fills it into the Log Match form.

uiElements.label: Hero picker remaining-tests gauge
uiElements.description: 5-segment parallelogram gauge (battery-meter style) centered horizontally inside each hero picker row. Green segments = games remaining in the current DPI/sens stage, grey filled (50% opacity) segments = already logged; quantized from that hero's active test batch_size/games_on_stage onto a fixed 5-bar scale.

uiElements.label: Hero picker empty state
uiElements.description: Empty-state message shown when no games have been logged for the current map/filter, prompting the user to pick a map or log a match.

uiElements.label: Recommended pick in-game sens
uiElements.description: In-game sens paired with the trending hero pick, derived from that hero's own best-tested DPI scale.

uiElements.label: Hero picker button
uiElements.description: Selects a hero from the Select Your Hero list (filtered to heroes with an active DPI test) and pre-fills it into the Match Log.

nodes.label: LogMatch.tsx
nodes.description: Match logging form: Deaths card (buffered death-axis tags), Match Details card (date/time/hero/map/mode/result/sens/feel-slider/notes, Log Match button), and a Recently Logged card listing today's entries.

uiElements.label: Deaths card
uiElements.description: Card that lists deaths buffered via the floating skull button during the current match, with a Clear all action and per-death remove controls.

uiElements.label: Clear all (deaths) button
uiElements.description: Button shown only when deaths are buffered; clears the entire in-progress death buffer for the current match.

uiElements.label: Death buffer list
uiElements.description: List of deaths logged so far this match, each row showing its axis label, a worded lean (or 'Neutral'), and an x button to remove that entry from the buffer.

uiElements.label: Match Details card
uiElements.description: Card containing the match-logging form; its header includes the Reset button that clears hero, notes, map, and feel.

uiElements.label: Reset button
uiElements.description: Clears the currently selected hero, notes, map, and resets the Feel slider back to its midpoint; disabled when nothing is selected.

uiElements.label: Match Cancelled button
uiElements.description: Cancels the match currently being built: clears hero, notes, map, feel, team rating, and the death buffer (with a confirm prompt if any deaths were already tracked), and calls notifyMatchLogged() with no args so Prematch's Map Voting picks reset too (bumps matchLoggedSignal without setting lastLog, so it doesn't also trigger the win/loss flash overlay). Sits beside Reset in the Match Details card header; unlike Reset it also clears the win/loss result and the death buffer. Scrolling/focusing the map search input is deferred a double requestAnimationFrame so it targets the post-reset layout (once the Map Voting card has actually collapsed) instead of the stale pre-reset one.

uiElements.label: Match Details form
uiElements.description: The full match-logging form (date, time, sensitivity display, hero, map, mode, result, notes, feel) that POSTs a new match to /api/matches on submit.

uiElements.label: Date input
uiElements.description: Date picker for the match being logged; defaults to today and auto-advances with the clock until the user hand-edits it (backfill).

uiElements.label: Time input
uiElements.description: Time picker for the match being logged; defaults to the current clock time and stops auto-following once hand-edited (backfill).

uiElements.label: Sensitivity display
uiElements.description: Read-only display of the in-game sensitivity this match will actually be logged at: the picked hero's active DPI test stage value if one's running (Competitive, or Quickplay-as-Support), otherwise the frozen fallback sens. Not editable from this form.

uiElements.label: 1st hero select
uiElements.description: Dropdown grouped by role (DPS/Tank/Support) for choosing the match's starting hero (pre-filled from the Pre-Match picker); each option shows today's play count for that hero. First of three hero slots — see logmatch-hero-switch-select-2/3 for the optional mid-match switches, all of which share the match's result on submit.

uiElements.label: 2nd hero select (mid-match switch)
uiElements.description: Optional second hero slot for a mid-match hero switch; grouped by role like the 1st hero select. The logged result and death buffer apply to every filled hero slot, not just the first.

uiElements.label: 3rd hero select (mid-match switch)
uiElements.description: Optional third hero slot for a second mid-match hero switch; grouped by role like the 1st hero select. The logged result and death buffer apply to every filled hero slot, not just the first. (Rendered by the same map as logmatch-hero-switch-select-2 — locate command matches both.)

uiElements.label: Hero role badge
uiElements.description: Colored pill (DPS/Tank/Support) that appears under the Hero select once a hero has been chosen, reflecting that hero's role.

uiElements.label: Map display
uiElements.description: Shows the map currently picked in the Pre-Match section along with its type pill, or a prompt to pick one there if none is selected yet.

locate.grep: grep -n -F -- 'Pick a map in the Pre-Match section above to log a result.' client/src/pages/LogMatch.tsx

uiElements.label: Map type badge
uiElements.description: Pill showing the selected map's type (e.g. Control, Escort, Hybrid, Push) next to the map name.

uiElements.label: Mode toggle (Quickplay/Comp Role/Comp Open)
uiElements.description: Three-button toggle for the queue mode this match is being recorded as (Quickplay Role, Competitive Role, Competitive Open); selecting one sets the mode used on log. Moved to the top of the Match Details form (first element, above Date/Time/Sensitivity) since it affects the Sensitivity display's value; a short line below the buttons explains which modes count toward the sens test.

uiElements.label: Result toggle (Win/Loss)
uiElements.description: Win/Loss toggle with an animated sliding fill and chevron rank-insignia buttons; selecting Win or Loss sets the outcome to be logged for this match.

uiElements.label: Main Perceived Factors textarea
uiElements.description: Free-text field for notes on perceived factors affecting the match (e.g. fatigue, warmup, stage change), saved with the logged match.

locate.grep: grep -n -F -- 'fatigue, warmup, just switched stage…' client/src/pages/LogMatch.tsx

uiElements.label: Feel slider(s)
uiElements.description: One range slider (0-100) per filled hero slot, capturing whether the sensitivity felt floaty (slow) or jittery (fast), snappy in the middle, on that hero during this specific match — captured live since the sensation fades before the next match. Container is logmatch-feel-sliders; each individual input shares this same data-inspect-id.

uiElements.label: Log Match button
uiElements.description: Primary submit button that saves the match to the database (POST /api/matches); shows Saving…/✓ Saved states and is disabled until hero, map, result, date, and sens are all valid.

uiElements.label: Save error banner
uiElements.description: Inline error message shown briefly under the Log Match button if saving the match to the server fails.

locate.grep: grep -n -F -- 'Failed to save — is the server running?' client/src/pages/LogMatch.tsx

uiElements.label: Today's Matches card
uiElements.description: Card showing today's logged matches, read live from the database so it stays accurate and resets automatically when the day rolls over. Each row expands in place into an inline edit form (logmatch-inline-edit-form) instead of a side drawer — this is the app's only surface for correcting a match's hero/map/mode/result after logging, or deleting it.

uiElements.label: Today's Matches list
uiElements.description: List of today's logged matches; each row's background is a subtle queue-mode-tinted wash (blue QP / red Comp Role / orange Comp Open) and shows an oversized W/L result watermark, a role-colored hero pill (mid-match switch heroes peek out behind it in progressively darker shades), a timestamp + stage/sens line, and the map name. Clicking the row toggles its inline edit form (logmatch-todays-matches-card-row / logmatch-inline-edit-form) open below it.

uiElements.label: Queue mode toggle (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: iOS-style switch (blue "Q"/red "C" flanking labels) inside a Today's Matches row's inline edit form. Clicking it PUTs a queue_mode flip (qp_role ↔ comp_role) to /api/matches/:id and calls revalidateAll. Comp -> QP prompts a window.confirm first — that direction rolls back the match's DPI-test stage credit (drops its blind_credits row server-side) and removes it from the Sens page's Awaiting Stats list. Moved here from an overlay on the collapsed row's watermark, now that the row expands into a full edit form instead.

uiElements.label: Today's Match row (click to expand)
uiElements.description: One row in the Today's Matches list. Clicking anywhere on the collapsed header (outside the mode toggle group) toggles logmatch-inline-edit-form open/closed beneath it for that match.

uiElements.label: Hero history strip (Today's Matches row)
uiElements.description: Up to 5 colored dashes below a Today's Matches row's hero pill — one per prior match on that hero, newest leftmost, green for a win / red for a loss; the oldest dash mask-fades out on its own trailing edge. Fixed to w-24, the same width as the hero pill. Backed by GET /api/matches/:id/hero-history.

uiElements.label: Map history strip (Today's Matches row)
uiElements.description: Same win/loss dash treatment as the hero history strip, shown below the map name for the last 5 matches played on that map. Backed by GET /api/matches/:id/map-history.

uiElements.label: Time/stage/sens label (Today's Matches row)
uiElements.description: This row's timestamp and stage/sens readout, absolutely positioned between the hero and map columns with fixed left/right rem offsets off the row card — holds its position regardless of how wide mid-match-switch peek pills make the hero column, instead of living in normal flex flow.

uiElements.label: Inline edit form (Today's Matches row)
uiElements.description: Expanded editable-fields panel for a Today's Matches row, matching the Awaiting Stats/Logged Today collapsed-row/inline-form pattern on the Sens page instead of a side drawer. Contains the Mode toggle, Hero (1st/2nd/3rd) selects, Map select, Result toggle, a Save Changes button, and a Delete this match control (with a confirm step).

uiElements.label: 1st hero select (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: 1st hero select inside a Today's Matches row's inline edit form, grouped by role like the main Log Match form's hero select.

uiElements.label: 2nd hero select (inline edit form, mid-match switch)
uiElements.description: Optional 2nd hero slot in the inline edit form's Hero section, for correcting a mid-match switch after the fact. Excludes whichever hero the other slot already holds.

uiElements.label: 3rd hero select (inline edit form, mid-match switch)
uiElements.description: Optional 3rd hero slot in the inline edit form's Hero section. (Rendered by the same map as logmatch-inline-edit-hero-switch-select-2 — locate command matches both.)

uiElements.label: Map select (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: Map select inside a Today's Matches row's inline edit form, with a map-type pill shown once a map is picked.

uiElements.label: Result: Win (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: Win/Loss result buttons inside a Today's Matches row's inline edit form. (Locate command matches both Win and Loss buttons.)

uiElements.label: Result: Loss (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: Win/Loss result buttons inside a Today's Matches row's inline edit form. (Rendered by the same map as logmatch-inline-edit-result-win — locate command matches both.)

uiElements.label: Save Changes button (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: Saves hero/map/result/mid-match-switch-hero edits for this match via PUT /api/matches/:id, then calls revalidateAll and collapses the row. Disabled while saving or if hero/map is unset.

uiElements.label: Delete this match button (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: Starts the delete flow for this match; requires a second tap on logmatch-inline-edit-confirm-delete-button to actually DELETE /api/matches/:id.

uiElements.label: Confirm delete button (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: Shown after tapping Delete this match; confirms the DELETE /api/matches/:id call.

uiElements.label: Queue mode toggle (inline edit form)
uiElements.description: iOS-style switch (blue "Q"/red "C" flanking labels) inside a Today's Matches row's inline edit form. Clicking it PUTs a queue_mode flip (qp_role ↔ comp_role) to /api/matches/:id and calls revalidateAll. Comp -> QP prompts a window.confirm first — that direction rolls back the match's DPI-test stage credit (drops its blind_credits row server-side) and removes it from the Sens page's Awaiting Stats list. Moved here from an overlay on the collapsed row's watermark, now that the row expands into a full edit form instead.

uiElements.label: Nothing logged today empty state
uiElements.description: Empty-state message shown in the Today's Matches card when no matches have been logged yet for the current day.

uiElements.label: Team rating stars
uiElements.description: Perceived teammate-quality rating, 0-5 stars in half-star steps, captured live at log time.

nodes.label: SensLog.tsx
nodes.description: Sensitivity-study control page: per-hero DPI stage-trial plan grid with Create/Cancel test buttons and phase tabs, the active DPI stage card with a 'Get next stage' advance control, an ad-hoc test-set creation card, a DPI stage results table, and the post-match combat-stats backfill area — an Awaiting Stats column (matches still missing combat details, expand-in-place to enter them) beside a Logged Today column (today's already-saved matches, expand-in-place to review/correct them).

uiElements.label: Overall accuracy % input
uiElements.description: Required percent input for a played hero's overall accuracy stat — one row per hero played (a mid-match switch gets one row per hero, since time-on-hero varies).

uiElements.label: Crit accuracy % input
uiElements.description: Optional percent input for a played hero's crit accuracy — one row per hero played, same multi-hero layout as sl-overall-acc-input.

uiElements.label: Combat stats inputs (Elims/Deaths/Damage[/Healing])
uiElements.description: Endgame-scoreboard number inputs — Eliminations, Deaths, Damage, plus Healing when any played hero is a Support — for the match being recorded. Final blows was dropped from this set.

uiElements.label: SensNav sub-navigation
uiElements.description: Renders the shared Sensitivity-section sub-navigation bar (defined in components/SensNav) at the top of the page.

uiElements.label: "Sensitivity Study" page header
uiElements.description: Top-of-page h1 title and intro paragraph describing the sensitivity-study workflow.

uiElements.label: Mouse acceleration curve card
uiElements.description: Surfaces (and, field-by-field, updates) the live Rawaccel Jump-curve params (GET/PUT /api/aim/curve) so Sean can set Rawaccel to match before playing. One live setting, not per-hero or per-phase — every match already gets whatever's currently saved stamped on it server-side. Editing locks automatically once any stage-test set goes active (sl-curve-params-lock-badge) so the curve can't drift mid-test. Rendered above the Backfill panel.

uiElements.label: Lock badge (curve params card)
uiElements.description: Shown instead of any edit affordance whenever `locked` is true (>=1 active stage-test set, via SensLog's dpiState.actives, passed down as the locked prop from the page component). Communicates that editing is frozen until the test finishes or is cancelled.

uiElements.label: Smooth/Input/Output field grid (curve params card)
uiElements.description: Three independently-editable tiles, one per Jump-curve field (CURVE_FIELD_META: smooth, input, output). Each tile is its own click-to-edit unit — editing one field doesn't touch the other two — rather than one shared Edit toggle for the whole card.

uiElements.label: Per-field edit button (Smooth/Input/Output)
uiElements.description: Template id `sl-curve-params-${field}-edit-btn` (smooth/input/output) — the field's displayed value doubles as its own edit trigger; disabled and greyed out when locked. Wraps the field's stat-tile value span (sl-curve-growth-rate/sl-curve-midpoint/sl-curve-motivity, unchanged ids from before this per-field rework).

uiElements.label: Per-field number input (Smooth/Input/Output)
uiElements.description: Template id `sl-curve-params-${field}-input` — shown for exactly one field at a time (editingField state), prefilled with that field's current live value on open.

uiElements.label: Per-field "Save" button (Smooth/Input/Output)
uiElements.description: Template id `sl-curve-params-${field}-save-btn` — PUTs the current live params with only this one field overwritten, revalidates, and exits edit mode on success; shows the server's validation error inline on failure.

uiElements.label: Per-field "Cancel" button (Smooth/Input/Output)
uiElements.description: Template id `sl-curve-params-${field}-cancel-btn` — exits edit mode for this field without saving.

uiElements.label: Smooth value (curve params card)

uiElements.description: Text line reporting total logged matches and count of distinct sens scales tested, plus a last-updated timestamp that refreshes whenever a study match's stats are submitted on the Enter Stats tab.

uiElements.description: Summary text showing total logged matches and distinct sens scales tested, plus a last-updated timestamp that refreshes when new match stats are submitted.

uiElements.description: Bulleted list of supporting reasoning points backing the DPI recommendation's verdict.

uiElements.label: What the Data Shows card
uiElements.description: Card presenting an auto-generated plain-language summary of what the charts below show, recomputed every time a match is logged.

uiElements.label: Auto-generated insights list
uiElements.description: Bulleted list of auto-generated insight sentences (best scale by accuracy, win-rate agreement, cold vs warm, adaptation, etc.) inside the What the Data Shows card.

uiElements.description: Card containing the Feel vs. Data quadrant chart comparing how fast a scale felt against how it actually performed.

uiElements.label: Peak Sens by Category card
uiElements.description: Card containing the Peak Sens by Category chart showing where each category (Overall, Hitscan, Projectile, each hero) peaks in accuracy.

uiElements.description: Badge reading 'Split may help', 'One sens fits all', or 'Not enough data' depending on whether tested categories' peak sens values cluster together or scatter apart.

uiElements.label: Peak Sens spread verdict badge
uiElements.description: Pill reading 'Split may help', 'One sens fits all', or 'Not enough data', summarizing whether tested categories' peak sens values cluster together.

uiElements.label: Peak Sens by Category scatter chart
uiElements.description: Scatter chart plotting each category's peak-accuracy sens value with labeled points, a shaded 'close enough to Overall' band, and a baseline mean-accuracy reference line; hovering a point shows the SpreadTooltip.

uiElements.label: Accuracy Over Time card
uiElements.description: Chronological (not scale-aggregated) scatter of every logged point's accuracy delta, colored by which scale was active, with a trailing 8-game rolling-average line — surfaces a practice-effect drift that the rest of the page's scale-aggregated views can't show, since they lose time order entirely.

uiElements.description: Card comparing performance on the first game of a session against later ones, to see whether a sens performs well from the start or only once warmed up.

uiElements.label: Cold vs. Warm stat tile grid
uiElements.description: Grid of stat tiles, one per cold/warm bucket, showing average accuracy, accuracy delta, felt speed, and sample size.

uiElements.label: Cold / Warm stat tiles
uiElements.description: Two stat tiles (Cold, Warm) each showing overall accuracy, accuracy delta vs. baseline, felt speed, and sample size for that bucket.

uiElements.label: Adaptation card
uiElements.description: Card comparing performance just after a sens change versus once settled in, to separate a genuinely worse sens from one not yet adjusted to.

uiElements.label: Adaptation stat tile grid
uiElements.description: Grid of stat tiles, one per fresh/settled bucket, showing average accuracy, accuracy delta, felt speed, and sample size.

uiElements.label: Fresh / Settled stat tiles
uiElements.description: Two stat tiles (fresh-off-a-change, settled) each showing overall accuracy, accuracy delta vs. baseline, felt speed, and sample size for that bucket.

uiElements.label: By Scale table
uiElements.description: Table listing every tested sens scale with eDPI, raw sens, sample size, win rate, overall/crit accuracy, felt speed, and accuracy delta vs baseline.

uiElements.label: By Hero table
uiElements.description: Table listing each tested hero with archetype, sample size, win rate, accuracy, and its optimal sens scale with accuracy deltas.

uiElements.label: Estimated Sweet Spot card
uiElements.description: Fits a weighted quadratic (accuracy delta vs. sens, weighted by games logged) through each category's (Overall + per-hero) tested scales, solved for its vertex — a continuous best-guess optimal sens rather than just whichever tested point scored best. uiElements.description: Plots the fitted quadratic curve (Overall only) sampled across the tested sens range, with the actual tested (sens, accuracy delta) points overlaid as dots and the fitted peak marked with a reference line — the curve fit's vertex, previously reported only as a table row, made visible as an actual curve.
